summary.headline: Deepak Nitrite Q4 FY26 consolidated EBITDA rose 13% YoY to INR383 crore, margin 18%, with PAT INR220 crore; management guides Q1 FY27 better than Q4.
summary.overview: Q4 FY26 consolidated revenue was INR2,127 crore, down from INR2,202 crore a year earlier but up from INR1,983 crore in Q3, while EBITDA rose 74% QoQ and 13% YoY to INR383 crore. Phenolics EBIT reached INR287 crore at a 20% margin, and Advanced Intermediates EBIT rose to INR34 crore. Management attributed the gains to favourable pricing, feedstock bought on dips before the Middle East disruption, and integration benefits. The nitric acid plant ran at about 45% utilisation in Q4 because of technical issues, so the expected INR90-100 crore EBITDA addition is delayed.

financial_highlights.change: -3% YoY vs INR2,202 crore; +7% QoQ vs INR1,983 crore
+13% YoY vs INR339 crore; +74% QoQ vs INR219 crore

segments.name: Advanced Intermediates
segments.commentary: Q4 revenue INR708 crore vs INR654 crore in Q4 FY25 and INR652 crore in Q3; EBIT INR34 crore vs INR15 crore in Q3. Gains came from stable volumes, end-product pricing and product mix, while exports slowed on logistics disruption.

segments.name: Phenolics
segments.commentary: Q4 revenue INR1,429 crore; EBIT INR287 crore vs INR239 crore in Q4 FY25 and INR145 crore in Q3, a 20% EBIT margin supported by spreads and downstream demand.

guidance_outlook: Q1 FY27 expected to be better than Q4 FY26 on both standalone and consolidated basis, and better than Q1 FY26.
FY27 expected to show stronger margins for standalone business vs FY26, driven by new downstream products that management calls significantly margin accretive.
Feedstock inventory bought on dips expected to support costs until price stabilisation, perhaps end-Q2 FY27 or mid-Q2.
New products and fluorinated molecules expected on regularised commercial production from Q3 FY27, in time for export customers' CY2026 requirements.
MIBK/MIBC plant expected to be commissioned around end-Q1 or early Q2 FY27.
Polycarbonate project expected to be commissioned by June 2028; PC resin and Phenol expansion may be offset by about a quarter.
capex_capacity: Nitric acid plant ran at about 45% utilisation in Q4 FY26 due to technical issues; under repair with technology and equipment suppliers; the earlier INR90-100 crore EBITDA addition target is pending stable operations.
Nitration and hydrogenation facilities at Deepak Chem Tech, Dahej, commissioned and stated as operating at expected productivity.
Multipurpose agrochemical intermediates and MIBK/MIBC projects: mechanical completion near; pre-commissioning next, commissioning around end-Q1 or early Q2 FY27.
Polycarbonate resin project (India's first fully integrated PC facility) targeted for June 2028 commissioning; total announced project around INR11,000 crore.
Praxair India to build, own and operate a dedicated on-site HyCO plant at Dahej under a build-own-operate model, reducing upfront capex for Deepak.
Funding: 60:40 debt-equity; bank debt tied up; equity contribution ongoing, with debt drawdown after 25% equity infusion.
demand_pricing: Domestic demand described as relatively stable across automotive, infrastructure, pharma, electronics and polymers; management says it is passing through raw material cost increases where possible, an ongoing exercise.
Advanced Intermediates realisations were lower than in earlier years, per management; capacity was reported as running full.
Phenol: domestic buyers' ordering pattern is mixed, with some back to normal buying and others still need-based. Management cited a China-India price spread but declined to comment on it.
China anti-involution and safety curbs on nitration chemistries seen as a structural tailwind for nitration products (DASDA, OBA-linked); management said this has already started on the ground.
Sulfur and sulfuric acid cost increases are a global headwind; management expects no significant net impact if India prices stay at par with international prices.
Management declined to give IPA or phenol production volumes.

qa_highlights.question: What was nitric acid utilisation in Q4 and is the INR90-100 crore EBITDA addition still on track?
qa_highlights.answer: Plant was at about 45% utilisation in Q4 due to technical issues; the balance was bought from the market. Target achievable once stable, but no timeline given. Concentrated nitric acid plant operating normally.

qa_highlights.question: Phenolics feedstock availability and China-India spread outlook for Q1-Q2?
qa_highlights.answer: Maintenance was preponed by about 10-11 days in early April; intermediate stock covered supply. Management guided Q1 profitability higher than Q4 and expects no propylene constraint. Declined to comment on other companies' spreads.

qa_highlights.question: Will the new products and fluorinated molecule add to FY27 standalone performance?
qa_highlights.answer: Validation batches are supplied or in transit to customers; commercial production on a regular basis from Q3 FY27. Management did not anticipate customer approval concerns.

qa_highlights.question: Why did receivable days rise?
qa_highlights.answer: Management said it moved some customers to dealership and CSA models to secure outstanding amounts amid volatility, and said realisations, not capacity utilisation, are the lower metric in Advanced Intermediates.

qa_highlights.question: Is the China nitration tailwind already visible?
qa_highlights.answer: Management said the CCP-led safety and transport audit is a structural tailwind, not tied to a specific province or product, and that it has already started happening.

qa_highlights.question: How will the polycarbonate project (about INR11,000 crore) be funded?
qa_highlights.answer: Sanjay Upadhyay: debt tied up with banks at 60:40; equity is being infused, and debt will be drawn after 25% equity per the bank condition. Management said funding is not an issue and cash generation is sufficient.

risks_watch: Nitric acid plant reliability: utilisation was about 45% in Q4; repairs and the timing of stable operations remain open.
Feedstock cost volatility (benzene, xylene, toluene, propylene); inventory bought on dips is expected to support costs only until around mid-Q2 FY27.
Working capital: receivable days rose, and some customers have moved to dealership and CSA models.

Execution risk on MIBK/MIBC commissioning (around end-Q1 or early Q2 FY27), new products (Q3 FY27), and the polycarbonate project (June 2028, possible quarter mismatch between PC resin and phenol expansion).
Sulfur and sulfuric acid cost increases; pricing gap between India and international markets.
Geopolitical risks in the Middle East and the US tariff and China policy environment.
summary.management_tone: Confident on near-term earnings momentum and guidance for Q1 FY27 and FY27, but evasive on specifics: production volumes, IPA margins, the China-India phenol spread, and nitric acid timing were not quantified. Management repeatedly used safe-harbour language and said it is cautious about extrapolating the current quarter.
key_quotes: So we anticipate Q1 to be better than Q4, which was, of course, better than Q3.
We are expecting it to be commissioned by June 2028.
So what you are seeing as underutilized is actually the realization which has gone down, not that the capacity had gone down.

adds.what: Polycarbonate resin project (India's first fully integrated PC facility)

growth.why: Management guides Q1 FY27 better than Q4 and FY27 standalone margins stronger than FY26, backed partly by MIBK/MIBC and agro-intermediate plants commissioning around end-Q1/Q2 FY27 and new downstream products from Q3 FY27, but the nitric acid plant is at about 45% utilisation with the INR90-100 crore EBITDA addition delayed and no revenue growth number given.
